Gauge starts at 100 (S2) and takes 2 charge-bursts to refill -> Super fires on her burst casts 1, 4, 7 (everyN 3, everyNOffset 1 — the engine feature added for this). During each 10s Super window she gains ALL THREE Super riders (the old model had only a smeared 262.79): +262.79% additional damage per full-charge shot (extraHitDamagePct), ATK +35.05 (S2 rider), Attack Damage +45.03 (burst rider). ORIGINAL NOTE: RL charge-attacker built around the Firepower Gauge. Firepower Gauge steady-state: gauge starts at 100 (S2 start-of-battle). Each burst either (a) fires Super Firepower when gauge=100 then drains it to 0, or (b) starts a 10s Firepower Charge that adds +1 (burst) + ~2/normal-attack + 45 (on end) ~= +60. Refilling 0->100 needs two charge-bursts, so Super Firepower fires only ~1 of every 3 bursts (its 10s window => ~8% of full-charge shots). S1 base Firepower Explosion (437.98%) modeled on every full-charge shot (shotFired). S1 Super-Firepower additional 262.79% modeled as a hitCount:12 flatDamage to encode that ~1-in-12 shots land inside a Super window (steady-state throughput; count is an estimate, flagged uncertain). S2 Maximum Firepower base ATK 80.04% on full-burst enter modeled; its Super-only +35.05% ATK and the burst's Super-only +45.03% Attack Damage are OMITTED because Super Firepower has low, non-gateable uptime (~1/3 of bursts). Burst unconditional Attack Damage 110.21% modeled. SKIPPED: S1 invuln/debuff-immunity/Healthy-Body heal (defensive); all gauge-plumbing lines (start +100, +2/attack, +45 on end, burst gauge <100 charge, gauge=100 drain) are bookkeeping for the cycle above; S2 full-burst-end 'burst-gauge fill +5% x gauge' (variable x gauge, burst-gen only); burst Explosion Radius +200% (inert, single boss). Numbers verbatim from skill text; the 1-in-12 frequency and the omitted Super buffs are the main approximations. KNOWN LOW-SEVERITY FIDELITY NOTE (S7 judge, faithfulness 0.93, GO): the +35.05% Super ATK rider is keyed to her burstCast (inside the everyN 3 / offset 1 Super block) rather than fullBurstEnter as the kit wording ('when entering Full Burst') literally reads, a construction that predates the selfStatus channel (2026-08-24), which can now express 'FB-enter gated on Super Firepower live' directly. This starts/ends her 10s 35.05 window ~22f (~0.37s) early — a marginal UNDER-credit (she is mid-burst-animation and fires nothing in that gap); cadence, magnitude, duration and self-scope are all correct. burstCast keying is deliberately preferred to a fullBurstEnter+everyN keying because the latter counts team FB entries and drifts out of phase with her own burst count whenever another Burst III takes a rotation (multi-B3 comps). Durable fix if the owner wants the literal encoding: add a fullBurstEnter trigger with a requiresSelfStatus gate on a Super-window selfStatus (the channel exists as of 2026-08-24) (would also let the 262.79 rider gate on the status rather than the cast counter).
GAUGE-ECONOMY RULING (owner, 2026-08-10, faithfulness Tier 0 / D4): a function-damage instance that lands on the boss SHOULD generate weapon-base burst gauge. The engine already does this for flatDamage (sim.ts `applyEffect()`, the `flatDamage` case), hitRepeat (the `hitRepeat` case) and DoT ticks (the DoT tick loop); the extraHitDamagePct rider path (sim.ts `firePull()`, the `extraHitDamagePct` rider path) is the sole omission, so this unit's rider deals damage and generates nothing. The asymmetry is REAL (gauge-truthfulness) but already BOUNDED, and it is NOT FB-visible in support-core comps: the committed instrument scripts/battery/u28-gauge-ab.ts converts each carrier's rider in-memory to a PERMANENT per-pull flatDamage — a deliberate over-emission — and all four carriers hold their full-burst count exactly (modernia 10=10, nayuta 5=5, neon-blue-ocean 11=11, neon-vision-eye 13=13), so the true asymmetry cannot move FB counts in that shape either. ⚑ Still unmeasured in the refill-bound charge-B3 comps, which is where gauge deltas actually bind — re-run the arm there before generalizing. NOT ENACTED unit-locally: it lands with the batched gauge cluster (fill-tempo + double-emit reproduce + this + theme-20 sourcing), whose corrections partially CANCEL (double-emit is gauge-DOWN, this is gauge-UP, tempo is comp-dependent), so the compensating-errors rule requires the full measured timeline in one pass via /scientific-method — docs/handoffs/2026-08-10-gauge-economy-findings.md and QUEUE.md ENGINE-WORK ORDER item 4.
